_comment: Porter MCP server for Continue.dev (VS Code + JetBrains, open source). HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into ~/.continue/config.json (JSON) or the equivalent section of config.yaml. Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. IMPORTANT: MCP tools are only exposed in Continue's Agent mode, not Chat mode. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Continue install here.
